question: What is the chemical formula of muriatic acid?
solution:
The correct answer is __**HCL.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Muriatic acid__ is the another name for __hydrochloric acid (HCl)__ which is an inorganic compound that is strongly acidic in nature.
 
• It has a wide range of applications - food additive, gelatin production, leather processing, industrial synthesis of PVC and vinyl chloride, descaling agent, dissolve rocks in oil production, steel pickling, etc.
